versions.changelog:
- Updated setup instructions to clarify where to view dashboard data and obtain an API key.
- Added links to the official product UI and direct API site for clearer onboarding.
- No changes to code or functionality.

Initial release of the Facebook Ad Library skill.

- Search and analyze Facebook/Meta Ad Library data via PPSPY integration.
- Tools provided for detailed queries on ads, ad-linked stores, landing pages, and products (13 tools total).
- Includes advanced filters, analytic reports, and advertiser/store/product insights.
- Simple setup with one required API key environment variable.
- Credits system: Searches use PPSPY credits; detailed queries are free.
